Subject: FintechCo deployment: Private vs Dedicated (SSO / KMS / logging) - follow up

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Thanks again for a great call today — I appreciate you walking us through the production requirements and constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

1) Primary concerns you called out:
   - SSO: SAML-based IdP with SCIM for provisioning (Okta today)
   - KMS/HSM: BYOK requirement; you run keys in AWS CloudHSM/AWS KMS with strict key separation
   - Logging/Retention: 7+ years of audit log retention for API calls and admin actions

2) Initial qualification:
   - Hosted API: best fit for fastest time-to-value but doesn't meet BYOK/CloudHSM or 7yr log retention controls you need today.
   - Dedicated: could meet many operational/isolation needs and supports KMS integrations (BYOK) depending on network/KMS configuration; log retention typically configurable but may require an enterprise add-on.
   - Private (VPC / on-prem): the only mode that natively meets strict CloudHSM / HSM attachments and long-term audit log retention in an isolated control plane.

3) Next steps I propose:
   - Please send the internal SSO/KMS/log retention spec you mentioned (we'll treat as high level ok) — Tom, you said you could share that doc?
   - Rishi (cc'd) will review KMS integration options and outline what's possible on Dedicated vs Private and where there are technical limitations. Expect a short note by Wednesday EOD.
   - If Private looks required after that review, we can schedule a short architecture session (30-20m) with your infra/security team to scope the VPC/on-prem options and produce a rough TCO and timeline.

I attached a short comparison doc (Dedicated vs Private) for your review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer to walk through instead of email.

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Attaching the internal spec (high level) you asked for. A few clarifications based on what we discussed: 

- SSO: Okta SAML + SCIM; we need automated provisioning and SAML 2.0 support.
- KMS/HSM: Keys are managed in AWS KMS backed by CloudHSM. We have a strict BYOK posture — we cannot export keys.
- Logging: All admin/audit logs must be retained for 7 years and stored in our S3 archive (encrypted at rest). We also need an immutable tamper-evident log for admin activities.
- Network: For Dedicated we'd need to understand private connectivity (VPC peering, private egress) and whether any outbound connections to Redwood-managed control plane are required.

We've attached the spec: FintechCo_SSO_KMS_requirements.pdf.

Tom — can you confirm whether this blocks Dedicated or if there's a path there? If Dedicated is viable we'd prefer that over a Private deployment for lower upfront lift, but only if security controls are comparable.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel

aisha@fintechco.com

Subject: Re: FintechCo deployment: Private vs Dedicated (SSO / KMS / logging) - follow up

Hi Aisha — thanks for the spec, that's very clear. High-level engineering read of options and constraints below (quick summary so we can decide next step):

1) SSO (Okta SAML + SCIM)
   - Hosted API: supports SAML/OAuth for customer-level SSO but doesn't support SCIM provisioning into a customer-managed identity store.
   - Dedicated: can integrate with SAML IdP for SSO; SCIM provisioning support depends on whether customer user store is accessible to the Dedicated control plane. Typically doable with private connectivity and SCIM endpoint routing.
   - Private: full SCIM support since the control plane is customer-managed and can reach internal endpoints.

2) KMS / CloudHSM (BYOK)
   - Hosted API: cannot meet non-exportable CloudHSM BYOK requirement. Keys managed by customer but still require a path we cannot provide in hosted mode.
   - Dedicated: we can support BYOK with AWS KMS customer-managed keys in many cases (e.g., CMK in your account with limited key policies) but CloudHSM-backed non-exportable keys are tricky — if your key material never leaves CloudHSM and we need to perform cryptographic operations within your VPC, Dedicated may be able to integrate via a customer-side KMS proxy or by colocating a key access gateway, but that increases operational complexity and may require Private for full assurance.
   - Private: native support for bringing your CloudHSM-backed keys and running all crypto operations within your control plane. This matches your BYOK requirement most directly.

3) Logging / Retention
   - Hosted / Dedicated: we can ship audit logs to your S3 and configure retention, but long-term immutable, tamper-evident storage typically requires Private where you control the retention and immutability guarantees. We can offer extended retention as an add-on for Dedicated but it comes with compliance attestations to be agreed.

Recommendation:
   - Based on your BYOK + CloudHSM requirement and 7yr immutable logs, Private is the most straightforward way to meet all controls with minimal risk. 
   - If you strongly prefer to avoid Private, we can scope a Dedicated deployment with a KMS gateway and extended logging add-on — this will require an architecture session and will likely add time to production rollout and some residual compliance risk to be documented.

Next step from our side: Marissa / I can put together a short note that maps the spec items to Dedicated vs Private gaps and an initial estimate of effort and TCO delta. Would you like that by EOD Friday (19 Jun) or early next week?

-Rishi
